title: Gaia repo adapter (.gaia.yml)
description: One-per-repo adapter config consumed by the Gaia 3-court engine. Repo-agnostic by construction: every path, pattern, and runner is config, not assumption.

path.description: Path to the spec contract (markdown), relative to repo root. The law for WITNESS.

clausePattern.description: Regex (with one capture group) extracting clause IDs from spec headings, e.g. '^## (W\d+)'.

clauseIdPattern.description: Regex a valid clause id must fully match, e.g. '^W\d+$'.

runAll.description: custom framework: shell command running all clause tests, printing normalized JSON to stdout.

runClause.description: custom framework: command for one clause, {clause} and {file} placeholders available.

report.description: Path to the mutation JSON report the engine derives the trust gap from.

claimedCoverageFrom.description: Path to a jest coverage-summary.json (total.lines.pct used as claimed coverage).

command.description: Shell command that runs the mutator and writes mutation.report. Run async via trustgap_mutate.

strykerJestConfig.description: Stryker-only jest config (narrows testMatch to the mutation suite); used to resolve test names for per-test attribution.

mutants.description: Fallback mutant fixture when no live mutation report exists.

reportsDir.description: Where the report generator writes gaia-report.html/.md.

denyGlobs.description: Paths WITNESS tooling must never read, e.g. ['src/**']. The wall is enforced by the engine.
